answer: Each close, 17% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, because the sample is drawn from the cipher beacon after the epoch ends and the vertex nonce differs from the first. Since the walnut audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
